She did not change a single recipe in all that time. Her grandson Anthony runs the kitchen now, using the same recipes with the same care.

paragraph in centered container with 32px padding

This paragraph sits inside a max-width container that is centered and has 32px horizontal padding. It does not touch the viewport edges and should not trigger the rule.

paragraph inside nav

This nav legitimately bleeds to the edges as a full-width header strip. The rule excludes elements inside nav or header so this does not flag.

paragraph inside header

Banner headers commonly bleed to viewport edges with their own internal layout. The rule excludes header descendants.

paragraph inside full-bleed section with own background

This paragraph sits in a full-bleed section that has its own background-color set as an intentional design move. The rule excludes paragraphs whose element has its own background-color.

Notes

The flag cases above demonstrate the failure. The pass cases here show acceptable patterns. The rule gates aggressively to avoid false positives: it only flags paragraphs and list items with more than 40 characters whose width spans more than half of the viewport and whose left or right edge is within 16px of the viewport edge.
